prompt.alinti: QOD's new Sonnet 5.5 just beat Cloud Opus at coding, and it only came out today. On the same coding test, it scored 71%, Opus scored 66%, and the last Sonnet scored just 10%. And get this, it's the first Sonnet to beat Pokemon Red all by itself, looking only at the screenshots of the game. Plus, it's over 30% faster and up to 30% cheaper per job than the last Sonnet. But in Anthropic, the creators of QOD say Opus is still the one for big, messy projects. Which means, picking the right cloud for each job makes your limits last way longer now. Good thing I made a cheat sheet that tells you which cloud to use for every kind of task, for the late comment Sonnet.
